name: 印鑑登録証明の申請規定を整備
summary: 印鑑登録証明の申請に関する規定があります。この議案で、出入国管理及び難民認定法などの改正に合わせ、申請に関する規定を整えます。
changes: 印鑑登録証明の申請に関する規定を整える
why: 出入国管理及び難民認定法などの改正に伴い、印鑑登録証明の申請に関する規定を整えるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Updates rules for applying for seal registration certificates
en.official: Regarding an Ordinance to Partially Amend the Kokubunji City Seal Registration Ordinance
en.summary: There are rules about applying for seal registration certificates. This bill updates those rules in line with amendments to the Immigration Control and Refugee Recognition Act and other laws.
changes: Update the rules for applying for seal registration certificates
en.why: The city says it is updating the rules for applying for seal registration certificates because of amendments to the Immigration Control and Refugee Recognition Act and other laws.
